description:
CODaS, delivered by the UNITE university network, combines communications engineering with data science for next-generation network technologies. For studies beginning in autumn 2027 the application window runs from 1 December 2026 to 5 January 2027 at 15:00 (GMT+2) — a short, well-defined window.

Programme Highlights

  • Communications-plus-data-science hybrid curriculum
  • Five-week window: 1 December 2026 – 5 January 2027 (15:00 GMT+2)
  • Bachelor's requirement of 180 ECTS or three years of full-time study
  • Pathways into 5G/6G research, telecom R&D and data engineering

Who Should Apply

Electrical engineering, telecommunications, computer science and applied mathematics graduates are the core applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the CODaS admission page during the December window and check the schedule section for document deadlines. Key deadline information: 5 January 2027 (15:00 GMT+2); application window 1 December 2026 – 5 January 2027.
